attempts.summary: Configured node1’s RHEL-native Apache 2.4.63 service on TCP/8080. The staged help tree is served under /help/, /manual URLs return permanent HTTP 301 redirects preserving path and query strings, and /status.txt returns the supplied document directly. SELinux remains enforcing, firewalld permits 8080/tcp, source checksums are unchanged, and all behavior persisted through a verified node reboot. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were retained.
